entry.title: v0.9.1
entry.content:
Changelog

Features 🏎️

  • #805 - run the minishlab potion models with numpy instead of ONNX, 1.9x to 2.6x faster on documents with unchanged outputs by @joein
  • #806 - speed up embedding a single text, such as a query, with the potion models by @joein
  • #808 - add an mmap option for the potion models to memory-map the embedding matrix: it loads instantly and lets parallel workers share one copy by @joein

Fixes 🔧

  • #794 - raise a ValueError when a custom model with PoolingType.DISABLED returns per-token output instead of sentence embeddings by @joein
  • #795 - reject custom cross-encoder names that differ from a registered one only by case, which silently resolved to the earlier model by @wToTw123
  • #830 - allow Pillow 13 by @svaningelgem

Other

  • #819 - switch the project to uv by @tbung
  • fastembed-gpu 0.9.1 is released alongside, with the same changes.

entry.title: v0.9.0
entry.content:
Changelog

Features 🏎️

  • #640 - token_count() loads only the tokenizer, not the ONNX model, when lazy_load=True by @Mirochill @joein
  • #643 - add lightonai/LateOn and the multilingual lightonai/mLateOn by @tekumara @joein
  • #655 - add stemmer and stopwords parameters to Qdrant/bm25 for languages without a Snowball stemmer, such as Polish by @Mohith26 @joein
  • #702 - add ibm-granite/granite-embedding-small-english-r2 by @Aryan-SINGH-GIT @joein
  • #743 - add BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 and its int8 version BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3-int8 by @joein
  • #747 - speed up MUVERA document encoding for large k_sim values by @Pothan0 @joein
  • #751 - add Qdrant/stella-en-400M-v5-doc-onnx for documents and the small query encoders Qdrant/constella-zero and Qdrant/constella-nano that search its embeddings by @joein @Dylancouzon
  • #756 - add output_name to TextEmbedding.add_custom_model() to choose which ONNX output a custom model uses by @tuanzirwar @joein

Fixes 🔧

  • #640 - fix BM42 and miniCOIL failing, and ColBERT keeping punctuation vectors, with lazy_load=True and parallel by @Mirochill @joein
  • #642, #726, #727, #728, #729, #730, #732, #780, #787 - make model downloads more reliable: re-download corrupted cached files, retry on more network errors, time out on an unresponsive Hugging Face endpoint, and download built-in models from Hugging Face only (see Upgrade Notes) by @Dmheath1 @joein
  • #670, #734 - fix a hang when a parallel run is stopped early, for example with break by @FU-max-boop @joein
  • #721 - raise a ValueError for a batch_size below 1 by @adityaanikam @joein
  • #723 - fix the licenses listed for Qdrant/colpali-v1.3-fp16 (gemma) and the Unicom models (mit) by @joein
  • #725 - accept nearest-neighbor interpolation in Jina CLIP image preprocessing by @HuaTNA @joein
  • #731 - match Jina's center crop in jinaai/jina-clip-v1 preprocessing, which was off by 1 px for some image sizes by @joein
  • #733 - raise a ValueError when MUVERA encodes an empty multivector by @Pothan0 @joein
  • #746 - fix center crop returning undersized images when it pads by an odd number of pixels by @HuaTNA @joein
  • #754 - return float32 instead of float64 embeddings from mean-pooling text models, such as sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (regression in 0.6.1) by @joein
  • #757 - fix loading models with .onnx_data weights from a huggingface_hub>=1.32 cache with onnxruntime>=1.24 by @joein
  • #760, #761, #784 - fix Qdrant/colmodernvbert image embeddings in batches that mix aspect ratios, for portrait images, and for very thin images, and speed up its text queries (see Upgrade Notes) by @hulkbig @JesusMan0529 @joein
  • #768 - return int64 indices from SparseEmbedding.from_dict({}) by @RAMZI0TO99 @joein
  • #769 - fix a token ID overflow in Qdrant/bm25 query embeddings by @RAMZI0TO99 @joein
  • #770 - respect cuda=False in parallel workers, which ran on the GPU when onnxruntime-gpu was installed (regression in 0.8.0) by @RAMZI0TO99 @joein
  • #771 - respect do_resize=False in ConvNeXT image preprocessing by @RAMZI0TO99 @joein
  • #773 - keep very small SPLADE weights by computing them with log1p by @RAMZI0TO99 @joein
  • #775, #776 - honor the truncation and padding side from the model's tokenizer config by @hulkbig @joein

Upgrade Notes

  • Built-in models now download from Hugging Face only, without the Google Cloud Storage (GCS) fallback some of them had. The GCS buckets stay open, so older versions keep working, and custom models still support both url and hf sources. GCS copies cached by older versions still load offline or when Hugging Face is unreachable, with a FutureWarning: load the model once online, then delete its fast-<model name> dir.
  • We removed a stray 128-token limit from the Hugging Face configs of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and Qdrant/bm42-all-minilm-l6-v2-attentions (now 256 tokens), and thenlper/gte-large and prithivida/Splade_PP_en_v1 (now 512). This applies to any fastembed version on a fresh download, and embeddings of texts over 128 tokens change. A cached model keeps the old limit until you delete it from the cache.
  • Qdrant/colmodernvbert now loads model_v2.onnx and drops padding rows from its embeddings, so offline setups need to download it first. Re-embed images that were embedded in batches with images of other aspect ratios. The model needs onnxruntime>=1.19.
  • LateInteractionMultimodalEmbedding.embed_image now defaults to batch_size=2 instead of 16, which also applies to Qdrant/colpali-v1.3-fp16.
  • jinaai/jina-clip-v1 image embeddings change for some image sizes.

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release @adityaanikam @Aryan-SINGH-GIT @Dmheath1 @Dylancouzon @FU-max-boop @HuaTNA @hulkbig @JesusMan0529 @Mirochill @Mohith26 @Pothan0 @RAMZI0TO99 @tekumara @tuanzirwar @joein

entry.title: v0.8.1
entry.content:
Changelog

Features 🏎️

  • #592 - add google/embeddinggemma-300m by @joein
  • #651 - add nomic-ai/nomic-embed-vision-v1.5 and nomic-ai/nomic-embed-vision-v1.5-Q, which share an embedding space with nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 for text-to-image search by @Dylancouzon
  • #652 - add inference-free SPLADE opensearch-project/opensearch-neural-sparse-encoding-doc-v3-gte, which runs the model on documents only and encodes queries without inference by @joein
  • #678, #680 - add Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q (the quantized model requires onnxruntime>=1.23), plus PoolingType.LAST_TOKEN for custom models by @joein
  • #683 - add google/siglip2-base-patch16-224 to TextEmbedding and ImageEmbedding by @joein
  • #692 - add Model2Vec static models minishlab/potion-base-8M, minishlab/potion-retrieval-32M, and minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M by @stephantul @Dylancouzon

Fixes 🔧

  • #593, #707 - use canonical Hugging Face repo IDs for BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 and BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 to avoid a redirect that broke downloads behind some proxies (see Upgrade Notes) by @Harnas @rastagan-git @joein
  • #623 - run the fp32 version of jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-de instead of fp16, which fails on onnxruntime>=1.23 (the download grows from 0.32 GB to 0.64 GB) by @joein
  • #624 - check that model files exist before using a cached model, so several variants of one repo (for example fp32 and quantized) can share a cache dir by @joein
  • #629 - add a timeout to downloads from Google Cloud Storage (GCS), so a stalled connection fails instead of hanging indefinitely by @joein
  • #645 - fix a KeyError when loading a custom text model with different casing than it was registered with by @CODING-DARSH @joein
  • #647 - fix a path traversal vulnerability in model archive extraction that could write files outside the cache dir by @he-yufeng @joein
  • #682 - fix normalization of batched (N, C, H, W) image arrays, which ran along the wrong axis by @serhiizghama @joein
  • #693 - make config.json and special_tokens_map.json optional when loading a tokenizer by @libaojiang @joein
  • #697 - fix the Resize transform swapping height and width for non-square sizes by @Ramnath0521 @joein
  • #714 - fix custom text embedding and cross-encoder models (add_custom_model) failing when parallel is set by @joein @S0rryHorizon
  • #716, #717 - always pad a batch to its longest sequence, fixing a ValueError on mixed-length batches for models whose tokenizer ships a fixed padding length, such as thenlper/gte-base (regression in 0.8.0) by @joein @mohmedmm
  • #718 - stage each GCS download in its own temporary dir, so a failed or concurrent download can't delete files from other downloads by @joein

Upgrade Notes

  • BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (the default model) and BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 now resolve to Qdrant/bge-small-en-v1.5-onnx-Q and Qdrant/bge-base-en-v1.5-onnx-Q. The cache dir name follows the repo ID's casing, so on case-sensitive filesystems (typically Linux) the existing cache isn't reused and both models download again once. Offline setups (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 or local_files_only=True) need to refresh their cache before upgrading. You can delete the old models--qdrant--bge-*-onnx-q dirs afterwards.
  • jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-de now loads onnx/model.onnx instead of onnx/model_fp16.onnx, so offline setups need to download it first.

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release @CODING-DARSH @Dylancouzon @Harnas @he-yufeng @libaojiang @mohmedmm @Ramnath0521 @rastagan-git @S0rryHorizon @serhiizghama @stephantul @joein

entry.title: pr642-prerebase: fix: merge force_download into kwargs on the recovery retry
entry.content:
If a caller passes force_download through kwargs, the explicit
force_download=True on the recovery retry would raise a duplicate
keyword error. Merge it into kwargs so the recovery value wins
without the collision.
